ValidationRule.description: Ensures "Risk Type" is blank when "Potential Risk" is "No Risk" for Latam-Non-Quality cases.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", TEXT($User.UserType) <> "AutomatedProcess", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Latam_Non_Quality",
OR(ISPICKVAL(High_Potential_Risk__c, "No Risk"), ISPICKVAL(High_Potential_Risk__c, ""), ISPICKVAL(High_Potential_Risk__c, "Low Risk")),
NOT(ISPICKVAL(Risk_Type__c, "")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: If 'Potential Risk' is "No Risk" / "Low Risk" / "None" then no values are allowed to be set in the 'Risk Type'
